# The Conversation

> > Independent news and analysis from academic experts, published under Creative Commons licenses across Australia, New Zealand, Canada, UK, Indonesia, and other global editions.

The Conversation is a nonprofit media organization founded by the Academic Journalism Society that publishes expert commentary and research-based analysis on topics ranging from climate change and health policy to statistics and ethics. Content is freely republishable under Creative Commons licensing, making academic expertise accessible to media outlets worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Academic journalism
- Creative Commons licensing
- Climate change and environment
- Public health policy
- Research-based analysis
- Content republishing
- Australian policy and politics
- Statistical literacy
- Editorial standards and moderation
- Global editions (AU, NZ, UK, CA, Indonesia)
- Expert commentary
- Science and technology
- Ethics and bioethics
- Community engagement

## Featured Analysis and Commentary

- [Environment – Views & Research – The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/nz/environment): NZ environment section: climate change, coral reefs, extreme weather analysis
- [Science + Technology – Views and Research – The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/au/technology): Australian science and technology research articles and analysis
- [Kesehatan - The Conversation Indonesia](https://theconversation.com/id/kesehatan): Indonesian health section covering infectious diseases and public health
- [Everything you need to know about statistics (but were afraid to ask)](https://theconversation.com/everything-you-need-to-know-about-statistics-but-were-afraid-to-ask-4532): Beginner guide to hypothesis testing, p-values, and statistical significance
- [Getting closer to our climate obligations: Australia's legislation for change](https://theconversation.com/getting-closer-to-our-climate-obligations-australias-legislation-for-change-4542): Australia's Clean Energy Future Package and Durban climate conference analysis
- [Australians can't ignore the health impacts of climate change](https://theconversation.com/australians-cant-ignore-the-health-impacts-of-climate-change-4523): Climate Commission report on heat waves and health impacts in Australia

## Health and Ethics

- [A challenge to our leaders – why don't we legalise euthanasia?](https://theconversation.com/a-challenge-to-our-leaders-why-dont-we-legalise-euthanasia-4463): Australian physician-assisted suicide and end-of-life care debate
- [Who's really looking after emergency department waiting rooms?](https://theconversation.com/whos-really-looking-after-emergency-department-waiting-rooms-4549): Victoria nurses' industrial action and ED triage system analysis
- [Ordering the vegetarian meal? There's more animal blood on your hands](https://theconversation.com/ordering-the-vegetarian-meal-theres-more-animal-blood-on-your-hands-4659): Controversial 2011 article on animal deaths in agriculture (later refuted)

## Research Methods and Critical Thinking

- [How David Beckham caused global warming: the Man U climate model](https://theconversation.com/how-david-beckham-caused-global-warming-the-man-u-climate-model-4548): Satirical take on spurious correlation and climate skepticism fallacies
- [False workplace bullying claims – we're not seeing an epidemic](https://theconversation.com/false-workplace-bullying-claims-were-not-seeing-an-epidemic-4479): Analysis of false workplace bullying claims using signal detection theory

## Media and Republishing Resources

- [Resources for media | The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/ca/resources-for-media): Media resources, Creative Commons content licensing, and expert access
- [Normas de republicación](https://theconversation.com/catalan/republishing-guidelines): Catalan republishing guidelines with Creative Commons attribution rules

## Optional

- [Community standards | The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/nz/community-standards): Comment moderation policy for curated editorial discussion streams
- [Charte de participation | La Conversation](https://theconversation.com/ca-fr/community-standards): French-language participation charter for community discussion standards
- [Standar komunitas | The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/id/community-standards): Indonesian community standards for fact-based discussion and moderation
- [Privacy policy | The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/ca/privacy-policy): Privacy policy under British Columbia Personal Information Protection Act
- [Terms + conditions | The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/africa/terms-and-conditions): User terms covering content submission and copyright licensing
- [Terms + conditions | The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/uk/terms-and-conditions): UK terms covering user content, publication rights, and author guidelines
